title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
summary: Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic, and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Andr
reason: Media-only coverage of a named product launch (Claude Duet, Anthropic) from a reputable outlet; no official owner announcement link and no observed author/page owner, so under rule 3-1's media-only model launch guidance it belongs to Industry rather than Model Releases.
